snippet.title: Outer Banks: Netflix Stories | Official Game Trailer | Netflix
snippet.description:
Ready to be swept away? Dive into a mystery, hunt for treasure and find unexpected romance in this choice-driven game based on the hit Netflix series.

Play Outer Banks: Netflix Stories on your mobile devices. Available exclusively on Netflix: https://www.netflix.com/game/81777755

About Netflix:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with 283 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.
